reference: GNU procps free is the parity oracle for the extra-operand status case. Deterministic numeric outputs are independent encodings of the documented free(1) formulas and units over the explicit fixture: used=MemTotal-MemAvailable when present, buff/cache=Buffers+Cached+SReclaimable, swap used=SwapTotal-SwapFree, with integer KiB/byte conversions. Bash type/help metadata and the version string are checked against their documented contracts.
coverage: Bash builtin type and help metadata plus documented loadable version
Default KiB Mem and Swap columns on a pinned meminfo fixture
Byte, mebibyte, gibibyte, and SI unit conversion
Repeated output count with a static fixture
exclusions: Full GNU numeric output comparison is deferred because GNU free cannot consume the candidate relative fixture and live proc counters change; the deferred reason specifies the required shared immutable procfs mock.
No live system counters are treated as expected values.

cases.purpose: Check Bash reports free as a builtin, its short help description matches the documented summary, and -V matches the documented loadable version.
cases.stdout:
builtin
free - Show memory usage from /proc/meminfo.
bashfree 1.0 (bash-loadable)

cases.purpose: Check only the used column against the legacy MemTotal-MemFree-buff/cache fallback when MemAvailable is absent; other columns are covered by the complete default fixture case.
cases.script:
printf '%s\n' 'MemTotal:     16777216 kB' 'MemFree:      2097152 kB' 'Buffers:      1048576 kB' 'Cached:      5242880 kB' 'SwapCached:       999999 kB' 'SwapTotal:      4194304 kB' 'SwapFree:      3145728 kB' 'Shmem:       524288 kB' 'SReclaimable:      1048576 kB' > meminfo
export BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=.
output=$(free -k)
memrow=${output#*$'\n'}
read -r _ _ used _ <<< "$memrow"
printf 'used=%s\n' "$used"

cases.purpose: Check --seconds and --count produce exactly two snapshots against an unchanged fixture; the script counts Mem rows rather than relying on timing output.
cases.script:
printf '%s\n' 'MemTotal:     16777216 kB' 'MemFree:      2097152 kB' 'MemAvailable:      8388608 kB' 'Buffers:      1048576 kB' 'Cached:      5242880 kB' 'SwapCached:       999999 kB' 'SwapTotal:      4194304 kB' 'SwapFree:      3145728 kB' 'Shmem:       524288 kB' 'SReclaimable:      1048576 kB' > meminfo
export BASHOS_PROC_ROOT=.
snapshots=$(free -k --seconds=1 --count=2)
mem_rows=0
while IFS= read -r row; do
  case $row in Mem:*) mem_rows=$((mem_rows + 1));; esac
done <<< "$snapshots"
[[ $mem_rows == 2 ]]
printf 'snapshots=%s\n' "$mem_rows"

cases.purpose: Check a missing relative meminfo fixture fails with a diagnostic and no data output.
An extra operand is rejected with status 1 and a diagnostic before reading procfs, matching procps free.
Full numeric output parity needs GNU free and the candidate to read the same immutable meminfo snapshot.
cases.reason: GNU free reads its mounted /proc and has no BASHOS_PROC_ROOT equivalent, while candidate fixtures can use a relative BASHOS_PROC_ROOT and live proc counters vary between invocations. A future disposable VM/mock must expose one immutable meminfo snapshot to both implementations or provide an independently reviewed procfs interposition layer.
